item.title: BLAST E-value estimates chance matches at least as good as the observed alignment
item.content: A BLAST E-value is the expected number of alignments with an equivalent or better score that would occur by chance in a database search of the given size. Lower E-values indicate stronger statistical significance.
item.explanationMarkdown:
An E-value is not the probability that the biological relationship is true.

For example, an E-value near `1` means roughly one match with this score or better would be expected by chance under the search conditions. An E-value of `1e-20` indicates that such a match would be extraordinarily unlikely to arise from random background alone.

E-values depend on factors including score and search-space/database size.

cards.prompt: What does a BLAST E-value mean, and what does a lower E-value imply?
cards.answerGuidance: It is the expected number of chance alignments with score at least as good as the observed one for the given search space/database. Lower E-values indicate greater statistical significance.
